That makes enrichment return 500 to ingest-api, which then shows up as 500s at the gateway. The SDK retry quota running out is a symptom. The disk warning at 14:26 doesn't match the error pattern.
SDK retries may have made the S3 throttling (503 SlowDown) worse.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check the AWS S3 us-east-1 status. Have enrichment-svc degrade gracefully, either by buffering or queueing artifact writes or by failing over to another region, so POST /v1/events doesn't fail when S3 is down. Tune SDK retries to use backoff.
